bullets.section: New blog post I’m excited to share
bullets.title: Revisiting Warren Buffett’s Advice to Me in 2008 (Plus: 7 Lessons for Young Investors)
bullets.note: ](http://tim.blog/2023/03/03/revisiting-warren-buffett-lessons-for-investors/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf)**”** An old video recently [resurfaced on social media](https://twitter.com/compound248/status/1626937279502594048). It’s yours truly asking Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger a question at the 2008 Berkshire Hathaway Shareholders Meeting. I was intensely nervous, and the audio makes that clear. This clip went viral, and a number of media outlets ([_Wall Street Journal_](https://www.wsj.com/articles/warren-buffett-will-get-the-last-laugh-on-upstart-wannabes-6d613309), [_Business Insider_](https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/tim-ferriss-show-podcast-buffett-munger-investing-stocks-index-fund-2023-2)_,_ etc.) reached out to me for comment, asking me questions like “What advice would you give a 30-year-old now who’d just amassed their first million?” I decided to take a few of my longer answers that didn’t make it into the pieces and write [a blog post](http://tim.blog/2023/03/03/revisiting-warren-buffett-lessons-for-investors/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) with more context.

bullets.title: HUMAN Extended Version, Volume 1
bullets.note: Sincere thanks to subscriber [Dave Thackeray](https://twitter.com/DaveThackeray) for originally [recommending this film on Twitter](https://twitter.com/DaveThackeray/status/1185284571820113920). It is beautiful, jolting, heart-melting, and brutal... all at once. The footage and stories blend into a powerful visual journey that evoked nearly every imaginable emotion in me. Here’s part of the description: “What is it that makes us human? Is it that we love, that we fight? That we laugh? Cry? Our curiosity? The quest for discovery? Driven by these questions, filmmaker and artist [Yann Arthus-Bertrand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yann_Arthus-Bertrand) ([@yannarthusbertrand](https://www.instagram.com/yannarthusbertrand/)) spent three years collecting real-life stories from 2,000 women and men in 60 countries. Working with a dedicated team of translators, journalists, and cameramen, Yann captures deeply personal and emotional accounts of topics that unite us all.” For more from project HUMAN, [check out their YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/user/HUMANthemovie2015/videos).

bullets.title: Alan Watts and Superposition — Listen, Dream
bullets.note: For me, Alan Watts can be hit or miss, but this is definitely a hit. Coupled with the ambient music, I find this meditation perfect for grounding myself when I’m making coffee in the morning. Here’s a shortened description of the project: “Superposition is an immersion into the inner universe, a meditative antidote to a world of digital overwhelm. Created by [Justin Boreta](https://tim.blog/2015/02/23/glitch-mob/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) ([@boreta](https://twitter.com/boreta)) and [Matthew Davis](http://namethemachine.com/about/) ([@davisville](https://www.instagram.com/davisville/)), this ambient project and record label emerged from the shared search for serenity by two curious artists.”
